review_candidates.description: We're Hiring: Aerospace Certification Manager Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Work Arrangement: Fully Remote About Us We are a globally focused organization committed to developing, manufacturing, certifying, and supporting high-quality aerospace products and systems. Our teams combine engineering, certification, quality, manufacturing, safety, supply chain, and program-management expertise to ensure aerospace products meet applicable regulatory, technical, and customer requirements. The Role We are seeking an experienced Aerospace Certification Manager to lead certification strategy, regulatory compliance, certification programs, technical coordination, authority engagement, and continued compliance across aerospace products and systems. The ideal candidate will manage certification activities from requirements definition and certification planning through compliance demonstration, authority review, approval, production readiness, and continued airworthiness or product compliance. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement aerospace certification strategies aligned with product, program, regulatory, and business objectives. Lead certification programs for aircraft, aerospace systems, components, equipment, modifications, or related products. Establish certification plans, compliance matrices, schedules, deliverables, responsibilities, and approval milestones. Interpret applicable aviation regulations, certification specifications, advisory material, standards, and authority requirements. Determine applicable certification bases and establish appropriate means of compliance. Coordinate certification activities with aviation authorities, designated engineering representatives, approved organizations, customers, and other external stakeholders. Manage certification interfaces with relevant civil aviation and aerospace regulatory authorities. Lead certification planning for new products, major changes, modifications, upgrades, and supplemental approval programs. Coordinate engineering teams in developing certification requirements and compliance strategies. Review system, equipment, structural, software, hardware, environmental, and safety requirements for certification implications. Develop and maintain certification compliance matrices and evidence-tracking systems. Define required analyses, tests, inspections, demonstrations, similarity assessments, and technical justifications. Coordinate certification test plans, procedures, witnessing, results, and reports. Review engineering analyses and technical reports supporting certification compliance. Ensure certification evidence is complete, traceable, technically sound, and properly controlled. Manage certification documentation, records, correspondence, approvals, findings, and authority comments. Coordinate resolution of certification findings, non-compliances, discrepancies, and open actions. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action activities associated with certification issues. Establish certification review gates and technical assurance processes throughout the product lifecycle. Coordinate with Design Engineering, Systems Engineering, Structures, Avionics, Software, Safety, Quality, Manufacturing, Flight Test, and Configuration Management teams. Ensure certification requirements are incorporated into engineering specifications and product-development processes. Review design changes for certification impact and determine whether additional compliance activities are required. Support configuration-control processes to ensure certified configurations remain accurately documented. Coordinate certification activities related to aircraft systems, propulsion interfaces, avionics, electrical systems, structures, equipment, software, and environmental performance as applicable. Support safety assessments, system-safety analyses, failure-condition assessments, and related certification evidence. Coordinate software and airborne electronic hardware certification activities where applicable. Support environmental qualification and certification activities covering temperature, vibration, humidity, EMC, lightning, altitude, and other applicable conditions. Coordinate structural substantiation, fatigue, damage tolerance, loads, and materials certification activities where applicable. Support flight-test certification programs and coordinate certification objectives, test plans, results, and authority participation. Ensure production and manufacturing processes remain consistent with approved or certified design configurations. Coordinate with Quality and Manufacturing teams on conformity inspections and certification-related production requirements. Support supplier certification activities and qualification of externally sourced aerospace components and systems. Review supplier certification documentation, compliance evidence, test reports, and declarations. Manage certification consultants, testing laboratories, engineering organizations, and specialist service providers. Define external partner scopes, technical requirements, deliverables, schedules, and quality expectations. Monitor external certification partner performance and technical deliverables. Develop certification schedules and monitor critical-path activities, dependencies, risks, and resource requirements. Manage certification budgets, testing costs, external engineering support, and program resources. Identify certification risks early and develop mitigation and contingency plans. Maintain certification risk registers and provide escalation for significant technical or regulatory issues. Monitor regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on current and future products. Maintain awareness of emerging certification requirements related to advanced air mobility, autonomy, electrification, sustainable aviation, connected systems, and emerging aerospace technologies. Establish certification knowledge-management practices, lessons learned, templates, procedures, and organizational standards. Train and mentor engineering and certification personnel on certification processes and regulatory expectations. Conduct certification readiness reviews, internal audits, and compliance assessments. Support regulatory audits, authority reviews, conformity inspections, and certification meetings. Prepare executive and program-level reports covering certification status, compliance evidence, risks, findings, schedule, costs, and approvals. Ensure certification activities comply with applicable quality-management, safety, configuration-control, and regulatory requirements. Continuously improve certification processes to reduce rework, improve evidence quality, strengthen traceability, and accelerate approval timelines. Key Performance Indicators Certification milestone achievement Certification schedule adherence Certification program completion Compliance matrix completion Compliance evidence acceptance rate Certification finding rate Major and critical finding rate Finding closure time Repeat finding rate Certification documentation accuracy Certification evidence traceability Test plan completion Certification test success rate Authority review turnaround Authority comment resolution time Regulatory compliance rate Certification risk closure Certification change-assessment turnaround Engineering compliance deliverable timeliness Supplier certification compliance Conformity inspection completion Flight-test certification performance Technical report acceptance rate Certification rework rate Certification-related schedule variance Certification budget adherence External consultant performance Testing laboratory performance Configuration compliance Audit finding closure Regulatory change assessment completion Certification readiness performance Training completion Certification process efficiency Approval cycle time Product certification status Continued compliance performance Lessons-learned implementation Ideal Candidate The successful candidate should have strong experience in aerospace certification, airworthiness, aircraft engineering, systems certification, regulatory compliance, aerospace quality, or aviation safety , preferably across aircraft, aerospace systems, components, or advanced aviation products. The candidate should demonstrate: Proven experience managing aerospace certification programs from planning through approval. Strong understanding of applicable aviation certification regulations and authority processes. Experience developing certification plans, compliance matrices, and means-of-compliance strategies. Strong knowledge of certification testing, analysis, inspection, demonstration, and technical substantiation. Experience coordinating with aviation authorities, certification bodies, approved organizations, and external technical specialists. Understanding of aircraft and aerospace systems, structures, avionics, propulsion interfaces, electrical systems, and safety requirements. Familiarity with software and airborne electronic hardware certification is highly desirable. Knowledge of flight-test certification and conformity processes. Strong understanding of configuration management, change control, traceability, and technical documentation. Experience reviewing engineering analyses, test reports, technical justifications, and compliance evidence. Strong knowledge of aerospace quality and airworthiness principles. Experience managing certification findings, corrective actions, and regulatory issues. Strong project-management, risk-management, and scheduling capabilities. Experience managing certification consultants, laboratories, suppliers, and engineering partners. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Excellent technical writing, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to work effectively with engineering, manufacturing, quality, safety, and program teams. Strong understanding of regulatory developments and emerging aerospace technologies.

review_candidates.title: HR Manager Experience in Manufacturing industry
review_candidates.description: HR Manager Experience in Manufacturing industry from 9 to 11 years Job Information Department: Human Resources Reports To: Factory Manager / Executive Management Key Interfaces: All Factory Departments, Finance, Production, Quality, Warehouse and Management Supervises: HR / Personnel staff as the function develops Job Purpose To establish, lead and operate the Human Resources function in a developing manufacturing environment, ensuring effective manpower availability, disciplined personnel administration, employee relations, performance support and compliance with approved HR policies and applicable labor requirements. The role is hands-on and is expected to build a practical HR foundation that can grow with the factory, with particular focus on blue-collar workforce management and factory operations. 1. HR Function Ownership & Daily Operations Take day-to-day ownership of the HR function and ensure essential HR activities are executed consistently and professionally. Build basic HR discipline, records, follow-up mechanisms and reporting required for a growing factory. Prioritize practical operational needs while progressively strengthening the HR function as the organization develops. Coordinate HR activities across recruitment, personnel, employee relations, performance support and training coordination. 2. Recruitment & Manpower Coordinate manpower requirements with department managers based on approved needs and organizational priorities. Manage recruitment activities for workers, technicians, supervisors, specialists and managerial positions within the approved hiring process. Source, screen and coordinate interviews, offers, onboarding and joining formalities. Develop practical recruitment channels suitable for factory and blue-collar hiring. Track vacancies, hiring lead time, joining rates, early turnover and recruitment effectiveness. Support manpower planning and identify recurring recruitment or retention problems. 3. Personnel Administration & Employee Records Ensure employee files, contracts, employment documents and personnel records are complete, accurate and properly maintained. Manage attendance, leave, shifts, overtime and employee-status changes in coordination with relevant departments. Ensure timely and accurate HR inputs required for payroll processing and review discrepancies before submission to Finance/Payroll. Follow probation periods, contract renewals, transfers, promotions, resignations and terminations according to approved procedures. Ensure personnel transactions and records comply with approved company policies and applicable labor requirements. 4. Factory Workforce & Employee Relations Maintain strong day-to-day presence with factory employees, supervisors and department managers. Handle employee complaints, workplace concerns, disciplinary matters and attendance-related issues fairly and consistently. Support management in addressing absenteeism, turnover, behavioral issues and workforce stability. Promote clear communication between employees, supervisors and management and escalate significant issues when required. Apply approved disciplinary and grievance procedures with appropriate documentation and confidentiality. 5. Performance Management Coordinate implementation of the approved performance-management cycle across departments. Support managers in setting clear objectives and performance expectations for employees. Track completion of performance reviews and follow up on agreed development or corrective actions. Identify recurring performance issues and provide HR input to management. 6. Training & Employee Development Coordinate training needs with department managers based on operational requirements, performance gaps and approved development priorities. Maintain training records and follow up on attendance and completion. Coordinate internal and external training arrangements within the approved budget and plan. Support induction and orientation programs for new employees, particularly factory workers and supervisors. Evaluate basic training effectiveness with relevant department managers. 7. HR Policies, Procedures & Compliance Implement and ensure consistent application of approved HR policies, procedures and authority levels. Identify policy or process gaps and raise them to management with practical recommendations. Maintain required HR documentation and support compliance with applicable Egyptian labor and social-insurance requirements in coordination with relevant specialists or external support when needed. Support internal or external reviews related to HR documentation and employment practices. Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information. 8. HR Reporting & Workforce Indicators Prepare regular HR reports covering headcount, vacancies, recruitment, attendance, overtime, absenteeism, turnover, training and other agreed workforce indicators. Analyze workforce trends and highlight significant risks or recurring problems to management. Maintain accurate HR data and support management decisions with reliable workforce information. 9. Systems, Restructuring & HR Development Projects Participate in HR restructuring, organizational development, HR system implementation and process-improvement projects. Provide operational HR input and factory workforce requirements during the design or redesign of HR processes and systems. Support testing and implementation of approved HR systems, controls and process changes. Implement and ensure compliance with approved HR processes and procedures and participate in their review and improvement. Identify operational HR gaps and provide feedback on the effectiveness of implemented systems and processes. 10. HR Team Development Support the gradual development of the HR team as the factory grows. Define clear day-to-day responsibilities for HR/Personnel team members within the approved organization structure. Coach and monitor junior HR staff and promote disciplined, service-oriented HR practices. Critical Role Boundary The HR Manager owns the day-to-day HR function and implementation of approved HR systems, policies and processes. The role participates in restructuring, organization design, major process redesign and transformation projects by providing HR and workforce input; it is not expected to independently act as the organizational restructuring consultant or system architect. The role is expected to remain hands-on. In the current stage, the HR Manager may directly handle several HR activities that would normally be separated into specialist roles in a larger organization. Candidate Profile / Hiring Benchmark Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Law or a related field. Experience: Approximately 5–7 years of progressive HR experience, preferably including at least 3 years in a manufacturing/factory environment. Target Level: Strong HR Supervisor, Senior HR Generalist or early-stage HR Manager ready to take ownership of a full HR function. Factory Experience: Proven exposure to blue-collar employees, production workers, technicians, shifts, attendance, overtime, employee relations and factory recruitment. HR Breadth: Practical exposure to recruitment, personnel administration, employee relations, performance management, training coordination and HR reporting. Knowledge: Working knowledge of Egyptian labor and social-insurance requirements relevant to factory employment. Systems: Good Excel skills and practical experience with HRIS, attendance or payroll-related systems is preferred. Personality: Hands-on, organized, fair, approachable but firm, able to work with workers and managers, capable of handling pressure and conflict without unnecessary escalation, and willing to build the function rather than wait for a large HR team. Core KPIs Time to Fill / Hiring Lead Time Vacancy Closure Rate % New-Hire Joining & Early Retention % Employee Turnover % Absenteeism Rate % Attendance & Personnel Data Accuracy % Payroll Input Accuracy & Timeliness % Employee File / Documentation Compliance % Performance Review Completion % Training Plan Completion % HR Request / Employee Case Closure Timeliness HR Reporting Accuracy & Timeliness

review_candidates.description: About The Company Willkommen bei der KfW! Als eine der führenden Förderbanken der Welt stehen wir für die nachhaltige Transformation von Umwelt, Gesellschaft und Unternehmen. Als Impulsgeber wirken wir aktiv an den Themen mit, die die Welt von morgen prägen. Wir fördern Windparks, Infrastruktur-Projekte, Schulen und Krankenhäuser und gestalten damit die Zukunft. Bei uns finden Sie ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Teamspirit, Vielfalt und Inklusion gelebt werden. Wir fördern Sie, Ihre Ideen und Ihr Engagement für Projekte, die die Welt verbessern. Bei uns finden Sie spannende IT-Aufgaben, denn wir gestalten die digitale Transformation und setzen dabei agile Methoden, moderne Infrastruktur sowie innovative Technologien ein. About The Role Werden Sie Teil des KfW Konzerns in Berlin und unterstützen Sie uns als DevOps - Engineer (w/m/d). In dieser Schlüsselposition sind Sie verantwortlich für die Konzeption und Implementierung zentraler CI/CD-Lösungen. Sie arbeiten eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen, um Automatisierung, Infrastructure as Code sowie Container- und Deployment-Komponenten in unsere Templates zu integrieren. Ihre Expertise sorgt dafür, dass unsere Entwicklungs- und Operations-Teams effizienter arbeiten und die Qualität unserer Softwareprodukte kontinuierlich verbessert wird. Sie spielen eine zentrale Rolle bei der Integration von Security Checks und Quality Gates, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Code-, Abhängigkeits- und Richtlinienprüfungen frühzeitig im Entwicklungsprozess erfolgen. Zudem setzen Sie Governance- und Best-Practice-Regeln um, wie Branch- und Tag-Logik, Artefakte und Caching, und treiben die Weiterentwicklung von DevOps-, GitOps- und Infrastructure-as-Code-Ansätzen innerhalb der Organisation voran. Als kompetenter Ansprechpartner unterstützen Sie Anwender bei Fragen, Problemen und bei der optimalen Nutzung der zentralen Pipeline-Templates, um eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit sicherzustellen. Qualifications Für diese Position bringen Sie ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer DevOps-Rolle, beispielsweise als Softwareentwickler oder DevOps-Engineer. Praktische Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Nutzung von Pipelines, vorzugsweise mit GitLab-Pipelines, ist essenziell. Sie besitzen solides Wissen in der Anwendungsentwicklung mit mindestens einer gängigen Programmiersprache wie Java, JavaScript, Python oder C#. Darüber hinaus haben Sie praktische Erfahrung mit Container- und Orchestrierungs-Technologien wie Kubernetes oder OpenShift. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab. Responsibilities Konzeption und Implementierung zentraler CI/CD-Lösungen unter Verwendung moderner Tools und Technologien. Integration von Automatisierungsprozessen, Infrastructure as Code sowie Container- und Deployment-Komponenten in Templates. Sicherstellung der Codequalität durch die Einbindung von Security Checks und Quality Gates im Entwicklungsprozess. Umsetzung von Governance- und Best-Practice-Regeln, inklusive Branch- und Tag-Management, Artefakte und Caching. Weiterentwicklung von DevOps-, GitOps- und Infrastructure-as-Code-Ansätzen innerhalb der Organisation. Unterstützung der Anwender bei Fragen, Problemen und der optimalen Nutzung der zentralen Pipeline-Templates als Ansprechpartner. Mitgestaltung und Optimierung der digitalen Infrastruktur sowie Förderung innovativer Technologien. Diversität & Inklusion: Wir fördern eine vielfältige Arbeitsumgebung mit Netzwerken, bedarfsgerechten Arbeitsplätzen und Chancengleichheit für alle, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Identität, Behinderung, Generation, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Gesundheitsförderung: Mit über 40 Betriebssportgruppen, Gesundheitskursen, einem betriebsärztlichen Dienst und Sozialberatung unterstützen wir Ihre Gesundheit aktiv. Weiterentwicklung & Trainings: Wir fördern Ihre fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch Trainings, Mentoring, Job-Rotation, Talentprogramme und Entsendungen. Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 38-Stunden-Woche, individuelle Teilzeitmodelle, Home Office & Workation, Sabbatical sowie 30 Urlaubstage bieten Ihnen viel Flexibilität. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft. Jetzt! Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen zur Position wenden Sie sich gerne an Vincent Schrötter. Equal Opportunity Der KfW Konzern setzt sich für Chancengleichheit ein und fördert eine inklusive Arbeitsumgebung. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Hintergründe, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Identität, Behinderung, Alter, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Unser Ziel ist es, eine vielfältige Belegschaft zu schaffen, die Innovation und Kreativität fördert. Wir sind bestrebt, eine Arbeitskultur zu pflegen, die alle Mitarbeitenden respektiert und unterstützt, um gemeinsam die Zukunft
